limitations: Synthetic paused Chromium at portrait 390x844 with software WebGL. Captures release contacts and pause; frequent automatic live/FIRE boundaries shorten waits. No human reaction-time or causal quality advantage inference. Continuous held-burst rearming comfort cannot be established. Physical phones, Safari, audio, hardware performance and continuous enjoyment unassessed.
Pausing closes KIT and clears AIM; no zoom or KIT assessment was attempted.

Automatic observation boundaries were respected and shortened route waits (roughly 2.97–2.99 seconds executed). No skipped action was assumed executed. Transport timing sometimes exceeded nominal FIRE budget: attempt2-coil2 reports 2145ms FIRE, attempt2-coil1 2250ms despite requested 1100ms waits. These were helper-reported timing overruns, not deliberate bypasses or reliable timing measurements.

Captures pause for inspection with approximately 3-second live / 1.2-second FIRE boundaries, affording repeated paused observations. This prevents claims about human reaction time, continuous enjoyment, sustained held-burst rearming comfort or a causal game-quality benefit.
Displayed accuracy is the game terminal statistic; exact manual misses versus cover impacts cannot be reconstructed from these views.
Recovered memories reading and other unvisited content were not graded for enjoyment.

reviewer: Independent visible-only mobile reviewer; assigned GPT-6.1 Sol; no agents.

method.input: JSON-lines native two-contact touch through tools/mobile-playtest.mjs; only --help read. Each returned screenshot viewed separately before dependent input.
method.identity: SOULFALL / BUILD 132 visible on title; source hash supplied by requester, not independently inspected.
method.scope: Exactly two fresh attempts, both actual terminal wins. No game source, tests, docs, prior reviews, recordings or hidden state inspected. Only own evidence/logs/report created.

learning_between_attempts: Learned the route/approach interaction and checked recovery names.
Learned to target visible coil AIM markers and follow MAP FIND ENTRY / HOLD ROUTE to the remaining coil.
Second attempt deliberately sampled DASH in a visible charging-patrol context; did not manufacture an evade success.
Used more assisted traversal with patrols alive in second attempt, preserving shield damage.
helpful_moments: Entry instruction directly links tap target, FIRE, scene swipe and DASH; TARGET DOWN feedback clearly confirms first engagement.
HOLD ROUTE, path arrows, changing HOLD APPROACH prompt and checked names made recoveries legible.
Threat direction buttons made offscreen patrols discoverable.
Boss percentages, OFF labels, OPEN timer, INERT COVER response and route prompt supported correction.
Distinct teal/gold rainy station presentation, clear result screen and explicit assist counts communicate identity and outcome.
frustrating_moments: Manual patrol FIRE drag batches spent only one round and left target alive in both runs. Fresh taps plus FIRE corrected them; cause cannot be assigned from visible evidence, and capture releases prevent assessing continuous held rearming.
Small guards and distant coils compete with low-contrast gray geometry; world text is tiny at 390px width.
Large lower control area and HUD reduce unobstructed portrait scene; threat cue competes with action reading.
First boss entry search required map/route help after two exterior coils; second run still hit inert cover before correction.
Assisted traversal can expose the player to offscreen attacks; second run lost shield near a recovery. Directional hit feedback helped, but did not remove that friction.

scores.scale: 0 unusable, 5 mixed/functional with substantial friction, 7 good with clear limitations, 9 excellent, 10 exceptional. Holistic observed mobile-emulation experience; not an average of category scores, win rate, desired target or physical-device certification.

reasons.overall_mobile: Coherent, finishable mission with strong atmosphere and helpful recovery feedback; manual combat uncertainty and crowded portrait targeting keep it from an excellent grade. Both wins substantially assisted; not evidence of manual-only quality.
reasons.controls: MOVE/FIRE drag, scene turn and DASH responded visibly, but patrol firing required corrections and DASH success was not confirmed. Continuous holds and physical thumb comfort unassessed.
reasons.gameplay: Recovery to multi-coil boss to defended upload gives observable progression, with readable damage/opening feedback and patrol pressure. Limited manual-combat sample and assisted travel constrain depth/enjoyment judgment.
reasons.presentation: Consistent teal/gold UI, rainy industrial setting, weapon model and composed title/results create strong visual identity. Audio and hardware rendering quality unassessed.
reasons.usability: Explicit instructions, route/approach assistance, map, recovery checkmarks and terminal assist accounting make progress recoverable. Boss entry and offscreen threats still needed interpretation.
reasons.readability: Main objective, health/ammo and end stats are clear. Distant enemies, coil targets and small environmental labels are harder to parse; bottom controls occupy substantial view.
